text: The breaking change this week is #13759, which removes CLEAN27 obsolete code from W1 and regional apps and deletes 140 AL files, so extensions that still use those objects need to move to the replacements. Several behaviour changes need attention. #13883 sets Process Returns As to Credit Memo for existing Shopify shops, so refunds no longer create sales quotes. #13582 restricts offered subscription packages to the customer's price group plus packages without one. #13720 splits the MS-STD configuration package into nine functional-area packages. #13361 lays the groundwork for Payables Agent v2.0, though v2 is not active yet. Fixes in finance and VAT include #14061 for TDS on multi-line purchase invoices, #13414 and #13467 for Spanish payment discounts with prices including VAT, and #13482 and #13805 for non-deductible VAT statistics. Warehouse and manufacturing fixes include #13552, #13699, #13724 and #13778, and #13704 adds quantity-ready-to-start tracking in Subcontracting. New capabilities include certificate authentication for master data synchronization in #13928, index statistics actions in #13893, Danish SAF-T for Austria and Iceland in #11849, and concurrent G/L posting in #9587. Extension points arrived in #13060, #9522 and #9523, and #13952 and #13953 add an email attachment key for faster deletion.

issues: #13361 also changes v1 behaviour now: v1 KPIs count finalized Purchase Invoices, and role center cues no longer count E-Documents. Saying only 'v2 is not active yet' leaves out these visible v1 changes.
#13467 and #13805 are 29.x backports of #13414 and #13482. The paragraph pairs them correctly but doesn't say they are backports.

Some behaviour-flagged changes are left out, such as #13824 (Fabric namespaces now lowercased), #13207 (Record Set Management skips missing tables) and #13572 (cloud migration now deletes the correct hybrid company). Leaving them out is fine for a summary.
